page.layout: One block of running text in one column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head centred above the text, page number at top right. Below the last line: catchword "Publi-" at right, signature "F" at left.

main_text.p: ,,funt in Anglia, præsertim si de Sacrificiis agatur, nec tribunalia æquitatis, nec, quæ ad clauum, Regina, sedeat. Immortales summo patri sunt habendæ gratiæ, quod sinceros magistratus integrosq;, & iudices incorruptos, si alicubi, in Europa; spectatissimam autem fœminam, Augustissimam Principem, si in orbe Christiano, aut vnquam, aut vspiam, nostro regno donauerit, {y}Fremuerunt certe Gentes, aduersus vnctam Domini, sed, qui sedet ab alto, ipsarum cõsilia ludibrio habuit. Quo acerbo felleoque magis animo contra nostræ Reip. Sionisque tranquillitatem coniurauerunt, quo venenatis magis linguis Sanctissimam Dominam, vt {z}Dauidem 5. Shimei, perculerunt, eo altiore & illustriore dignitatis eminentia, & istam & illam extulit, euexitq; mundi Dominus, vtramq; conspicuam, & amicis & inimicis, tanquã in medio coelo Solem proponens. Beatum Albioni dedit Deus seculũ vt calamitati eius inhiantib. & oculi defecerint, & ora exaruerint; lectissimæ autem Principi, {a}vitam prolixam, imperium secumcurum, domum tutam, exercitus fortes, Senatum fidelem, populum probum, orbem quietum, & quæcunq; hominis aut Cæsaris vota sunt: vt, cui Italus maledixerit, ei Dominum vberem in modum benedixisse, satis superq; contestatum fiat. Fruatur, precamur, tali {b}Debora, in æternum, patria, matre in Israele: fruatur tali populo Regina beatissima, inuitis quibuscunque, exitium tam preciosæ animæ imprecantibus. Ita erant apud nos, spectatæ probitatis iudices, & iustitiæ tribunalia. Quin vt deliris istorum somniis paulisper geramus morem: Esto, Pontifex hancipsam, subditosq; suos, censura Ecclesiastica legitima perstrinxerit. An maiores hoc fulmen habiturum vires est, quã illud, de quo Christus, Excommunicationis nodos laqueosq; designans, {c}Dic Ecclesiæ: Quod si Ecclesiam audire 17.neglexerit, sit tibi velut quispiam Ethnicus, & quispiam Publicanus. Sitigitur tanquã Ethnica; simus omnes, vt Publicani. Placet etenim ita ludere, animi gratia. An Ethnicis data fides, an Publi-

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right: ",," (ditto mark at the top), "y Psalm.11." (before "Fremuerunt"), "z 2.Sam.16" (before "Dauidem"), "5." (a separate small mark beside "Shimei"), "a Tertullian." and "in Apologetico cap.30." (beside "vitam prolixam"), "b Iudic.5.7." (beside "Debora"), "c Matth.18." (beside "Dic Ecclesiæ"), "17." (beside "audire"). The note lines were transcribed as the printed marks and references; the text under "Psalm" and "Sam" is printed as shown. Italic passages reconstructed from the scan; "tico.cap.30." is the second line of the Tertullian note. Marks "{a}", "{b}", "{c}", "{y}", "{z}" are placed at the reference points in the text. The "Sitigitur ... Publicani" line was read as roman type. Some letters in the small italic lines are doubtful, especially "tanquã" and "Shimei"; no [?] was added because the scan is legible enough to read them.
